comparison.objective: Return a CD to its jewel case, snap it onto the hub, and close the lid catch.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge grasp of a wide thin disc, sub-millimeter hub alignment, snap seating, and lid latching.
comparison.success_condition: Disc fully retained by the hub teeth and lid caught shut after release, without mishandling the case or disc.
comparison.reason: PR-2342 tests precision insertion and two snap engagements. The candidate tests controlled agitation and classification by physical aperture passage, not seating a single part.
